title: A Robot Solved Rubik's Cube In 0.38 Seconds
hook: A robot solved Rubik's Cube in just 0.38 seconds.
closing: At 0.38 seconds, the robot made elite human speed look slow.
question: Could you even scramble it that fast?

segments.say: Rubik's first world championship record took 22.95 seconds, setting the human chase.
The human record reached 3.13 seconds after decades of faster solving.
The robot finished in 0.38 seconds, leaving the fastest human far behind.
